text:
Maya: Heads-up 1st-century problem: several contractors convert mid-Dec and some accepted offers include prebooked travel during the holiday shutdown. Need quick guidance on accruals/carryover and exceptions.
Eli: Do we ever carry contractor PTO into FT balance on conversion or is it always pro-rated from FT start date?
Signe: I'm converting 2024-12-22 and have a non-refundable trip 12/27-12/29. How do I file to avoid losing days?
HR Bot: Policy TL;DR: contractor balances do not auto-transfer. FT accruals start on official FT start date and are pro-rated. One-off credits can be approved for documented, non-refundable commitments made before offer acceptance.
Maya: Shutdown dates: 2024-12-24 to 2024-12-26 and 2024-12-31 to 2025-01-01 = hard blackout (no approvals). 2024-12-29 to 2024-12-30 = soft blackout (possible with manager + oncall coverage signoff).
HR Bot: Exception form: https://redwood.example/hr/pto-exception. Required: name, id, conversion date, requested dates, manager approval screenshot, backup coverage plan, supporting docs (booking, receipts).
Eli: Is there a standard cap on one-time credits?
Maya: Typical cap is 5 days for these exceptional credits; reviewed case-by-case. If conversion is within 7 days of the shutdown we expedite review.
Signe: Filing now with booking confirmation and offer. Tagging my manager for approval.
Maya: Please include oncall lead in the form when requesting soft-blackout days. For Eng infra use Marcus, Platform use Lee, SRE use Ana. We'll route if unspecified.
Eli: Thanks 10x. Makes hiring ops easier if we inform candidates about blackout windows up front.
Maya: Agreed 1 will add to pre-offer checklist and update People Ops FAQ after this batch.
